## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
library(readxl)
house = read.csv("House Prices.csv")
head(house)
```

Beberapa variabel numerik memiliki nilai NA seperti : LotFrontage, MasVnrArea,GarageYrBlt
```{r}
numericVariabel = c('LotFrontage','MasVnrArea','GarageYrBlt')
library(ggplot2)

for (i in numericVariabel) {
 histogram = ggplot(house, aes_string(x = i)) +
             geom_histogram()
 print(histogram)
}


```
Dari histogram, data tidak berdistribus normal dan terdapat outlier sehingga NA dapat diisi dengan median
```{r}
house$LotFrontage[is.na(house$LotFrontage)] = median(house$LotFrontage, na.rm = TRUE)

house$MasVnrArea[is.na(house$MasVnrArea)] = median(house$MasVnrArea, na.rm = TRUE)

house$GarageYrBlt[is.na(house$GarageYrBlt)] = median(house$GarageYrBlt, na.rm = TRUE)
```
